notes.title: Demo Update v0.3
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm excited to announce that I've just released a new update to the Bloody Downsizing demo! I've made some changes and improvements that I think you'll really like.

[h2]New weapon: Tygeron[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43111007/b2d485b971319b30f673f1c4996c571ef6327427.png[/img]
I've added a new weapon to the game, the Tygeron SMG. I think this weapon is going to be a game-changer, as it's perfect for close-quarters combat and can deliver a lot of damage in a short amount of time. I can't wait for you to try it out and let me know what you think!

[h2]Weapon card redesign[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43111007/44fc24f2278b0568ddcf58d2c633bfa088d52dc6.png[/img]
I've given the weapon cards in the weapon shop a fresh new look. Now you can see the actual picture of the weapon instead of a simple icon, making it easier to choose your next favorite weapon.

[h2]Weapon stats and prices[/h2]
I've made some minor updates to the weapon stats and prices to ensure the game balance remains fair and exciting.

I hope you enjoy the new update and continue to have a great time playing Bloody Downsizing. As always, please let me know if you have any feedback or suggestions.

Thank you so much for your support!

Best regards,
Gabor

notes.title: Demo Update v0.2
notes.content:
Greetings players,

I have some exciting news to share with you today! I'm releasing an update to the Bloody Downsizing demo that removes weapon reloads, making combat smoother and more fluid.

Reloading weapons didn't quite fit the combat style of the game. It forced players to run away instead of engaging in combat, which detracted from the overall experience. With this update, you'll be able to focus more on the action and less on reloading.

I understand that some players may have enjoyed the reload mechanic, but I believe this change will benefit most players and improve the overall gameplay experience. I appreciate your feedback and hope you'll continue enjoying Bloody Downsizing with this new update.

As always, I welcome your comments and suggestions, and I'm committed to making Bloody Downsinzing the best it can be. Thank you for playing and I'll see you in the game!

Best regards,
Gabor
